QUOTE: Every handler write goes through one method, `BaseDataOperator.batchRecords`. ... `ServerDataOperatorBase` (`handlers/index.ts:31`) is the base. It extends `BaseDataOperator` ... `mix(ServerDataOperatorBase).with(...)` ... Every `ServerDataOperator` handler, including the three product handlers, writes through `batchRecords`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says all handler writes go through `batchRecords` inherited from `BaseDataOperator` via the base class. It never says the mixins are constrained to extend `ServerDataOperatorBase`, which is the reason the item requires.
